headline: Ryder Raises Full-Year Earnings Guidance and Expands Fleet Investments
summary: Transportation and logistics company Ryder System raised its annual earnings forecast and expanded investment in its commercial rental fleet following robust financial results in the third quarter.
why: Ryder operates commercial fleet management and supply chain logistics solutions across North America, serving as an indicator for freight volume demand.

impacts.name: Ryder System Inc
impacts.why: Upgraded profit outlooks and fleet capital expansion reflect resilient commercial logistics demand.
